item.title: ASKING ERIC: Conflict at concert stage ruins band fan’s tradition
item.description: Dear Eric: I have been attending shows of local bands for more than two decades and have met a very nice group of people who go to these shows and developed many nice friendships. Due to health reasons, I normally sit in the chairs in the back, will wander and socialize at times and sometimes at the intermission I will go up to the front of the stage, (standing area, not regulated) and socialize and stay for a few songs.

item.title: KDOT accepting applications for grants available through TA program
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT) is accepting applications for $32 million in available grant funding for construction projects through the Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program.

item.title: Kansas Corn Growers Association holds annual meeting
item.description: At its annual meeting held at the Kansas Corn Symposium in Salina on Feb. 3, the members of the Kansas Corn Growers Association elected board members for the northwest, north central and northeast districts.

item.title: National Weather Service announces 2026 storm spotter training schedule
item.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) in Dodge City has released its 2026 spring storm spotter training schedule, offering residents across southwest Kansas multiple opportunities to learn how to identify severe weather and stay safe during storm season.

item.title: GCCC to host Women’s Day showcase
item.description: Garden City Community College’s bUSters United will host its fourth International Women’s Day showcase on Friday, March 6, celebrating women-owned businesses and creatives from across the region.

item.title: Museum history program set for this week
item.description: Six more free programs are coming up in the Finney County Historical Museum’s Evening at the Museum and History at High Noon lecture series, including lunch hour segments at noon the second Wednesdays and 7 p.m. programs the third Tuesdays of February, March and April.

item.title: Timtiman wins Finney County Spelling Bee
item.description: Elementary and middle school students from USD 457 Garden City, USD 363 Holcomb, St. Mary Catholic School and St. Dominic Catholic School showed off their spelling skills at the 2026 Finney County Spelling Bee on Saturday.
